data.one_liner: A simple slide-to-action widget for Flutter inspired by Android Slide To Act.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable slide-to-unlock or slide-to-action widget that adapts to your theme. It handles horizontal drag gestures to trigger actions with built-in animations.
use_when: You need a swipe-to-confirm or slide-to-unlock mechanism in your UI
You want a customizable slider widget that fits your theme easily
avoid_when: You need complex form validation or form-specific widgets
You require an extensive UI component library beyond a single sliding widget
strengths: Supports multiple platforms including mobile and web
weaknesses: Limited to a single specific UI pattern (slide to act)
Sparse documentation beyond a basic example
